text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's New Year's, and I'm in my office.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Aha! I knew it. I saw the light on, so I figured you'd be here…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Anyway, Happy New Year. May the new year bring you peace, joy, happiness… and all that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Come on, it's just the standard New Year's greeting. Don't get so worked up.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, and here.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: A New Year's card. You're my trainer, after all. Thanks for all you do and stuff.
choice_data_list: Whoa… you wrote a card and everything!
Whoa… you wrote a card and everything!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What are you getting so excited about? This is pretty standard, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, whatever. That's it for the pleasantries. Now let's get to work.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I want to take on the Classics this year, so we can't afford to slack off.
choice_data_list: We need to come up with a strategy.
You can't skimp on rest, either.
We'll have to collect a lot of data.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Exactly.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: After I'm finished with training, let's start scoping out the competition.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe, the year's only just started and there's already so much to do. I really can't afford to slouch around!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The year has barely begun, but Daiwa Scarlet and I have already started preparing for her next race.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Well, obviously.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But I'm not going to rest just for the sake of it, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Good grief… That was a rhetorical question.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We stay careful of Daiwa Scarlet's physical condition during her first training session of the year.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe, so you're just as fired up as I am. Wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Then let's not dawdle. It's time to get right back to running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We spend some time at the track, where Daiwa Scarlet does sprints with a satisfied grin on her face.
